body: I feel its a bad design to have access control requirements in v1. I feel they belong in v12 so v12 is complete. I suggest we do this for all documentation requirements **_when we can_** so each section is as complete as possible in and of itself. I do not like the idea of having to hop to several different sections to get requirements for one category.

comments.body:
I don't think we need another opened issue for that, as I responded (https://github.com/OWASP/ASVS/issues/2065#issuecomment-2331341039) just 15min ago in another issue

> What we going to do with current V1 content is up to separate discussion #1063 / #1831
Fair enough, you can close this out.

Most likely we have too few V1 requirements and it makes sense to move documentation requirements as first section for each chapter, written here: https://github.com/OWASP/ASVS/issues/1063#issuecomment-1831655824

labels.name: _5.0 - prep
labels.description: This needs to be addressed to prepare 5.0

title: Move all documentation requirements out of v1 and into their respective sections when possible
